item.name: Carl
item.about: Host that gives free tables to people due to there being no stores to spend money at.

item.name: Roland Cosplayer
item.about: He is found outside the house and beside the doorframe near the player spawn.

item.name: Construction Workers
item.about: Construction workers that work for 2x2, they were ordered to block off an entrance due to it being dangerous.

item.about: Only speaks in gibberish, gets angry when insulted.

item.about: Fan of Glebus and likes its cool trick.

item.about: Says "gleeb" as a cool trick. Gets more vexed the more you talk to it.

item.name: Investigative Iris
item.about: Investigator that uses hashtags when speaking, is looking into a painting with the number 4 on it that seemed off to them.

item.name: Letter
item.about: A letter in a mailbox addressed to a specific person.

item.about: Sits at a table, claims he's the goat at Forsaken. (he ain't) He then admits he's lowk buns at the game. (he is)

item.name: Greg
item.about: Sits at a table, still waiting for Pizza Guy's pizza.

item.name: Mart
item.about: Watches the TV on the second floor of the main house. Only says "panda".

item.name: D3functB0t
item.about: Based off of the [https://roblox.fandom.com/wiki/Catalog:Shoulder_Helper_Bot Helper Robot] and hat. They talks in a quirky style with rapid use of emoticons, replacing vowels with numbers, and random spam of special characters used as an expression of anger.

item.name: Grandfather Clock
item.about: as the name suggests, a 'Grandfather Clock'. It stands in the corner of Lobby and when interacted with will activate and deactivate AFK mode for you.

item.name: Envelope
item.about: An envelope meant to explain more of the lore of Forsaken.

item.about: A riddling fish that makes references to several philosophical stories.

item.name: Ben
item.about: An out-of-bounds character that is meant to be a 'Roblox anomaly.'

item.name: Red Herring
item.about: A troll NPC made to made to distract players from the lore of Forsaken.

item.name: WANTED
item.about: A wanted poster of Taph.

item.name: Photo
item.about: A photo of Noob and some of their friends.

item.about: Stands at the top of the staircase, he says nothing, he only stares.

item.about: An NPC that likes waffles.

A wandering soul in the Lobby.
